coverage: Partition reservation stalls, all four blocked and rotating reserved native partition
reset_scope: Fresh reset before each scenario; midflight reset not tested.
stale_response_scope: C++ rejects repeated completed-frame response ID; RTL negative response test not executed.
numerical_scope: RTL delivers 36,864 nonconstant BF16 halfwords checked against global-address oracle. Host C++ multiplies delivered operands and compares stage products. No Verilog compute or full GEMM execution is tested.
payload_capture: RTL group payload read at STS commit. Each group is written once per drained stage, so no intervening update is possible in this supported path. General store-data capture is not validated.
implementation_scope: Behavioral blocking edge-order reproduces frozen C++ component. Not full-chip RTL equivalence, synthesis readiness, or calibrated hardware timing.
partition_rule: One issue per unblocked partition per cycle; context round-robin cursor per partition; partition updates0..3 serialize shared queue allocations.
blocked_partitions: Four-bit input reserves partitions for native compute; scenario3 exercises all blocked and rotating single-partition reservations.
